chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup semi-final, in Tashkent. Argentina play France. Number eight is Luciano Gauna, a winger. He tries three shots. Argentina win three two, and reach the final!

chapters.label: How he beats a defender
chapters.text: This is how he beats a defender. He drives at him, fast. The defender backs away. Then stop! The sole stops the ball, and pulls it inside. The defender is stuck. Shoot!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Slow motion. Drive, stop, change direction, go!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: drive at the defender, then use your sole to change direction!
